payload.previous_feedback: Previous vetter reason: The proof establishes exactly the claimed inequality 0 ≤ x - floor(x) for an arbitrary real x using the defining property floor(x) ≤ x. The argument is correct, complete for this lemma, and matches the stated role in the assembly.
payload.previous_proof_nl: Let x be an arbitrary real number. By the definition of the floor function, floor(x) is an integer satisfying floor(x) <= x. Subtracting floor(x) from both sides gives x - floor(x) >= 0. Since x was arbitrary, this holds for every real x. Hence, for all real x, 0 <= x - floor(x).
